auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: a signed-out visitor is redirected to /signin when opening /workspace, /library, /reports, or /settings
a signed-in user only sees plans and workspace preferences owned by that user
signing out hides workspace content and returns the browser to the sign-in page

routes.name: Sign In
routes.purpose: Authenticate users with the platform auth controls before accessing saved floor plans.

routes.name: Workspace
routes.purpose: Create, select, edit, pan, zoom, undo, redo, and save SVG floor plans.

routes.name: Library
routes.purpose: Browse fixture templates available for placement in plans.

routes.name: Reports
routes.purpose: Preview, export, and print summaries for saved plans.

routes.name: Settings
routes.purpose: View account status and edit workspace preferences.

routes.name: Home Redirect
routes.purpose: Send signed-in users to the workspace and signed-out visitors to sign in.

summary: An authenticated Lumen Layouts SVG floor-planning workspace where users create durable plans, manipulate fixtures on a pan/zoom canvas, undo and redo edits, switch plans, export summaries, and print reports.

deferred.reason: the requested workspace only requires in-app SVG planning and export of a plan summary
the request requires user-owned durable plans, not simultaneous collaborative editing
brightness editing is required as fixture state, but physically accurate rendering is not requested

entities.name: authSession
relationships: authSession represents the visible sign-in form state and authenticated browser session, not durable user data

entities.name: plan
relationships: a signed-in user owns many plans
a plan stores many fixtures inside its fixtures JSON state

entities.name: workspacePreference
relationships: a signed-in user has workspace preferences that can reference the active plan
